copy.blurb: For now, the model and The Market agree on England versus Ghana to within a point on every side — and 'for now' is the operative phrase. The inputs that usually separate two numbers — the confirmed eleven, fresh injury and fitness news, weather at the venue — haven't landed yet, so today there's nothing pulling the prior away from the price. That makes Pass the correct read today, not a permanent one. The model's three-way (78% / 10% / 12%) sits on top of the market's shape. The engine refreshes as kickoff nears; if news moves enough of the prior, this can turn into a Pick. Until then, there's no gap to show. Two outlets covered the build-up this week — BBC Sport (football): "Foden and Palmer to miss out on World Cup squad"; The Guardian (football): "handing a surprise recall to Ivan Toney"
